title: fix(app-shell): a dashboard draft the server refuses to read stays unopened in Studio Interfaces, whatever order the designers load in
body:
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb53xYKskegHeLV9gUxkwMmb)_ Fixes #29884 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none The two lines are copied from the claim (comment 6600806534). ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：Studio Interfaces 打开一个服务器拒绝读取（403）的仪表盘草稿时，不论设计器先加载还是后加载，都只显示拒绝说明，不再打开空白的属性表单、画布和项目工具（Source），自动保存也没有任何可发送的内容。 - 为什么改：#29015 的修复只在设计器先注册时成立。内置设计器是动态加载的，多数新打开的页面（以及"所有元数据"里的项目链接）首屏没有设计器，于是空草稿被当成已加载；之后在 Source 里改一下，就会无版本前置条件地覆盖草稿（实测 200），草稿的权限门和所有仅草稿的改动丢失，发布后仪表盘对所有人可见。18.3.0 挡版项的修复不完整。 - 风险与回滚：只改拒绝读取（403）那一个分支，让它像对象、流程、应用三处已有的拒绝分支一样收回草稿归属。可读草稿、无草稿、其他读取失败的路径不变。回滚即撤销本 PR。 - 先看：`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 叶子加载里 `'refused' in draftRead` 分支新增的五行；新测试 describe（`StudioDesignSurface.draftUnreadable-29015.test.tsx` 末尾）。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.draftUnreadable-29015.test.tsx`，预期 6 个用例全部通过。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes - **Where the hole was.** The built-in designers register through a dynamic import, so the Interfaces pillar's first render can find no dashboard preview (`isEditable = !!Preview && !StudioCanvas` is false). That render takes the no-designer arm of the leaf load, which installs the leaf's clean `{}` buffer and stamps it as the leaf's (`setDraftFor(leafKey)`, objectui#11272). When the preview registers, the load runs again and reads the draft. On a 403 its refused branch (added by #29132) only set the strip's error and returned, so the stamp stayed. To `useDraftAutoSave` a stamped buffer is a loaded one, so the canvas, the Properties inspector and the item tools (Source) opened on `{}`, and the autosave was live with no version pin. A reload of a leaf whose earlier read was answered (a publish, a rollback) kept its loaded buffer the same way. - **The fix.** The refused branch now takes the leaf's buffer back: `setDraft({})`, `setDraftFor('')`, `forgetLeafVersion()`, the read address cleared, `setIfDirty(false)`. The object (`setObjDraftFor('')`), flow (`setDraftFor('')`) and app nav (`setAppDraftFor('')`) refused branches already do this. - **The no-designer arm is kept as it is.** objectui#11272 needs that leaf's clean `{}` buffer. While `!isEditable`, the autosave is blocked (`blocked: !current || !isEditable || …`) and the inspector needs `isEditable`, so the arm sends nothing by itself. The hole was only the refusal keeping its stamp. - **Census of the other editors this surface hosts.** The object and flow loads have no pre-registration arm that stamps ownership (both effects start at `if (!current) return`), and their refused branches, like the app nav's, already clear. Only the Interfaces leaf had this ordering. - **The "All metadata" deep link is the same load.** `/studio/PKG/metadata/dashboard/NAME` navigates a dashboard to the Interfaces pillar (`StudioMetadataArea` → `areaItemPillarPath`), so it is covered by the same fix, not a second editor. ## Tests A new top-level describe in the #29015 shared harness, `StudioDesignSurface.draftUnreadable-29015.test.tsx`. The designer registries are module state with no unregister, and the file's `beforeEach` registers the dashboard preview, so each late-registration case loads the pillar and its registries afresh (`vi.resetModules`), with nothing registered. Each case first asserts the stamped state (the Source tool is shown and the draft has not been read), then registers the preview and a default inspector inside `act`. - **Interfaces route, late registration:** the strip with the server sentence shows; no canvas, no inspector edit, no Source tool; no save after the autosave window; the stored draft still carries `requiredPermissions`. - **The area's deep link:** the same, mounted at the URL `areaItemPillarPath` gives for `/studio/PKG/metadata/dashboard/NAME`. This mounts the landing the area navigates to, not the area route itself. - **Same-leaf reload:** a readable draft opens, then a `publishNonce` reload is refused; the loaded buffer is taken back and nothing is sent. - **CONTROL, readable draft after late registration:** it opens editable, and an inspector edit saves the served draft (its `requiredPermissions` included) pinned `ifMatch: 'v1'`. - **CONTROL, early registration:** the existing #29015 case (preview registered in `beforeEach`) still refuses, unchanged.
Red at main, green with the fix, ablation - At main `00f72f94` with only the test commit: `Tests 3 failed | 3 passed (6)`. All three new cases red on `expected 
 to be null`; both controls and the #29015 case green.
- With the fix: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 6 passed (6)`.
- Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the refused branch's `setDraftFor('')` replaced by `setDraftFor((prev) => prev)` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `a60c33a4f242` → `ec0372a0a886`). Result: `Tests 3 failed | 3 passed (6)`, the same three red. Restored: blob == HEAD (`a60c33a4f242`), `git diff HEAD` empty. No build is involved: ui vitest aliases app-shell to `src`.




Neighbour sweep and type-check (head 1a9786f9, after merging main)

- Every ui test file naming `InterfacesPillar` (57 files, the harness included), two locked batches at `--maxWorkers=2`: 29 files / 155 tests passed; 28 files / 283 tests passed.
- Narrowing, declared: the 223 files naming `StudioDesignSurface` are not all run locally; the touched code is the Interfaces pillar's leaf load, and CI's Test UI runs the rest.
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell` (65 tasks, test files included): exit 0.
- `eslint` on the two touched ui files: 0 errors; the 36 warnings all predate this PR (none is on a line it adds).



## Acceptance notes

- **Live, card steps 1–7** on a fresh showcase backend and the Console Vite dev server: a writable package, a published dashboard with one metric widget, an app whose nav names it, and a draft with `requiredPermissions: ['showcase.export_data']` (admin's draft read: 403).
  - Before (main's `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` served): 7 of 7 fresh loads (5 on Interfaces, 2 by the deep link) show the strip AND the empty Properties form (5 form controls) and the item tools. A Source edit to the published body sent `PUT …?mode=draft&package=…&surface=studio` with no If-Match, answered **200**, and admin's draft read flipped 403 → 200 (the gate was gone). That happened on both routes.
  - After (this branch): 9 of 9 fresh loads (5 + 2 loads, plus the two edit attempts) show only the strip, with 0 form controls, no item tools and no PUT. The draft read stays 403.
  - The swap was restored (blob == HEAD), and the after leg was re-run once Vite served the restored file again.
- Probe script, JSON readings and screenshots: `/mnt/project-files/issue-29884/shots/`.
- `Fixes #29884` is on the third line, after the project attribution block, which the session requires as the body's first two lines.

## Verification

Local gate union on the final head `58c3a3f7` (main merged twice; the second merge brought 5 backend-only commits, none touching `ui/`):

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 35 families for the 3 changed paths (182 changed lines).
- The 34 non-vitest families: all `exit 0` on `58c3a3f7`, among them `check-sdui-manifest.mjs` (exit 0, the record does not move for a logic-only edit), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: on `1a9786f9` (the first merge), `Test Files 170 passed | 2 skipped (172)`, `Tests 4979 passed | 2 skipped (4981)`, exit 0. The re-run on `58c3a3f7` finished green after this PR opened (4979 passed; card report 6604287278). The second merge touched no `ui/` file.
- `dispatch-gates --ran` on `1a9786f9`: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- CI runs the rest: Type Check UI, Test UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI and the required set.
